description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake's Account 360 team is expanding! We are looking for a Senior Technical Account Manager to join our team.

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don't just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset, who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

This role combines hands-on technical and commercial responsibilities. On the technical side, you will be a trusted advisor to customer technical and business leaders across your book of business, leading the most complex post-sales engagements and delivering measurable outcomes across Architecture and Performance, BCDR, Platform Continuity, and Observability and Alerting. You will have the depth to challenge customers' architecture decisions and guide them in the right direction, and you will use AI to scale how outcomes are delivered across the team. You will partner with Product, Engineering and Support to advocate for customer-impacting issues at scale. On the commercial side, you will work closely with account teams to drive growth for customer use cases by engaging with stakeholders and developing actionable plans. This will require you to leverage your technical skills and expertise to engage and communicate effectively at all levels within an organization.

You possess a positive attitude and outlook and enjoy working with a high-performing, fast-paced team. You are results-oriented, leveraging data, metrics, and open feedback to make operational, tactical, and strategic decisions.

As a Senior Technical Account Manager, you will:

  • Build trusted, executive-level relationships with customer technical and business leaders, in person and virtually, as the customer's advocate across Snowflake

  • Lead discovery across your book of business to identify the outcomes that matter most, and shape multi-quarter technical plans with customers and account teams

  • Lead customers through Well-Architected Framework outcomes, including security hardening (MFA, SSO/SAML, RBAC), DR/BCP readiness, AI observability and alerting design, platform modernization, and performance and cost optimization

  • Take on the most complex engagements, challenging customers' architecture decisions and guiding them toward the right long-term direction

  • Partner with SE, AFE, and FCTO stakeholders to shape joint account strategies that accelerate customer outcomes and adoption

  • Communicate with confidence to executive audiences, turning complex technical topics into decisions and measurable results

  • Advocate for customer-impacting issues at scale with Product, Engineering and Support, using evidence from across your book of business to influence priorities

  • Leverage AI tools to develop scalable playbooks, skills, and automation that enable the broader CX organization to deliver technical outcomes faster and more consistently

  • Mentor TAMs and serve as a go-to expert in your specialization or industry

  • Willingness to travel regionally to customer locations


Our Ideal Senior Technical Account Manager will have:

  • B.S. or M.S. degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

  • Deep hands-on experience with Snowflake, SQL and Python

  • 8+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles such as Solutions Engineer, Data Platform Architect, Data Engineer, or Data Scientist, working directly with enterprise customers

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with modern data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery

  • Expertise in an industry such as Retail/CG, Financial Services, Healthcare and Life Sciences, Manufacturing, or Technology, Media and Telecom

  • Recognized depth in at least one of Architecture and Performance, BCDR, Platform Continuity, or Observability and Alerting, with strong working knowledge across the others

  • Hands-on experience applying AI to real problems, with the understanding to guide customers on how to adopt AI well

  • Experience working within the partner ecosystem as it pertains to Snowflake solutions

  • A track record of diagnosing and resolving complex, high-impact technical problems and leading senior customer leaders to a decision

  • Experience creating assets others adopt, such as playbooks, runbooks, reference architectures, or enablement

  • Excellent verbal and written communication, facilitation, and listening skills, with strong executive presence

  • High levels of emotional intelligence (EQ), empathy, proactivity, and the ability to advocate for both customers and internal teams

  • Successful experience working, collaborating, and establishing relationships with leadership, colleagues, and clients

  • Excellent team player able to work with virtual and global cross-functional teams

Nice to Have:

  • Data and AI platform certifications a plus

  • Snowflake SnowPro Advanced Certification strongly preferred

  • Experience publishing or presenting technical content, such as blogs, conference talks, or customer workshops

  • Experience leading resiliency, disaster recovery, or observability programs in enterprise environments

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com
